keys.name: TOP_APPROACH
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis holds high-step height; root spacing is small before the edge

keys.name: EDGE_UNWEIGHT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis advances toward edge without dropping; trailing/high foot still owns root

keys.name: LOWER_PROBE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis still holds high while the leading foot reaches the lower plane; touch is not yet root ownership

keys.name: LOWER_ACCEPT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: lower foot earns support before root descent; brief mixed-height dual support is explicit

keys.name: ROOT_DROP
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis descends only after K3 support acquisition; acceleration is downward then arrested by low support

keys.name: TRAIL_RELEASE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root remains low while the old high foot releases; no rebound to the old support height

keys.name: LOW_REACQUIRE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: trailing foot reaches the low plane while root travel decelerates into a stable base

keys.name: BOTTOM_RESTACK
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis remains at low-step height; both feet support and root spacing settles
